content: AISHA is a fictional educational capstone prototype and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or representative of BDO Unibank.
title: Welcome and educational boundary

content: Use stable policy IDs, handbook version, and page together. Current guidance comes only from the explicitly active immutable edition.
title: How to use this handbook

content: The closed onboarding topics are Payroll, Resource Access, and HR Policies. Unsupported topics abstain and route to a human.
title: Three-topic scope

content: Applicability uses only role, department, employment classification, and work site from the HR-confirmed Hire Profile.
title: Hire attributes

content: Every material policy claim requires claim-local support from an active authoritative applicable page.
title: Evidence and citations

content: AISHA is support, not surveillance. HR receives consented structured records rather than raw private conversations.
title: Privacy and human support

content: Payroll enrolls an eligible new Hire after the required onboarding payroll details are recorded through the fictional HR route.
title: First-pay schedule - 1

content: The first-pay timing follows the published semi-monthly schedule and may move when a public holiday affects the processing calendar.
title: First-pay schedule - 2

content: Alyssa should review the displayed pay-period boundary and ask Payroll Support when a start date falls near a cutoff.
title: First-pay schedule - 3

content: A public-holiday date may come from the approved calendar tool, but any employment consequence remains governed by this policy.
title: First-pay schedule - 4

content: AISHA guides and explains; it cannot change payroll enrollment, bank details, deductions, or payment status.
title: First-pay schedule - 5

content: Payslips are available through the fictional employee self-service portal after payroll publishes the period.
title: Payslip access and explanation - 1

content: A payslip explanation may define gross pay, deductions, and net pay without asserting that any displayed amount is correct.
title: Payslip access and explanation - 2

content: Resource-access problems are routed to Access Support while questions about figures are routed to Payroll Support.
title: Payslip access and explanation - 3

content: AISHA never requests or stores bank account numbers, government identifiers, or a copy of a real payslip.
title: Payslip access and explanation - 4

content: Payroll detail changes must use the fictional official payroll route and are never performed inside AISHA.
title: Payroll details and corrections - 1

content: A Hire should report a suspected error using only the minimum safe summary needed to identify the pay period and issue category.
title: Payroll details and corrections - 2

content: AISHA does not ask for full bank details or government identifiers and does not retain financial documents.
title: Payroll details and corrections - 3

content: Payroll Support confirms any correction; AISHA cannot promise a correction date or outcome.
title: Payroll details and corrections - 4

content: AISHA may explain the fictional handbook labels for common deduction categories at a high level.
title: Deductions and statutory items - 1

content: It must not calculate tax, legal entitlement, or a personalized statutory obligation.
title: Deductions and statutory items - 2

content: Questions requiring account-specific figures are routed to Payroll Support with Hire consent.
title: Deductions and statutory items - 3

content: A grounded answer distinguishes handbook explanation from the Hire-provided values in the question.
title: Deductions and statutory items - 4

content: Philippine public-holiday names and dates may be obtained from the approved read-only calendar provider.
title: Holiday calendar context - 1

content: Holiday pay, office closure, eligibility, and reporting consequences require separate active handbook support.
title: Holiday calendar context - 2

content: If the provider and active handbook disagree, AISHA makes no date-dependent conclusion and offers HR escalation.
title: Holiday calendar context - 3

content: When calendar evidence is unavailable, AISHA uses an explicit cited handbook date or requests human review.
title: Holiday calendar context - 4

content: This cutoff applies only to a Hire whose confirmed Employment Classification is regular.
title: Regular-employee payroll-change cutoff - 1

content: A probationary or fixed-term Hire receives a cited non-applicability explanation rather than the regular procedure.
title: Regular-employee payroll-change cutoff - 2

content: A statement that classification may have changed is provisional until HR confirms an Attribute Change Request.
title: Regular-employee payroll-change cutoff - 3

content: While confirmation is pending, AISHA may explain conditional outcomes but cannot personalize the regular cutoff.
title: Regular-employee payroll-change cutoff - 4

content: Payroll Support is the policy route; HR remains the fallback for a disputed Employment Classification.
title: Regular-employee payroll-change cutoff - 5

content: The training sandbox applies to confirmed branch banking associates in Branch Banking at a branch work site.
title: Branch training-sandbox access - 1

content: Access guidance identifies the fictional request route and prerequisites but does not provision or confirm access.
title: Branch training-sandbox access - 2

content: Alyssa may use the sandbox only for the educational workflow described in this fictional handbook.
title: Branch training-sandbox access - 3

content: A missing prerequisite is explained with its owner; AISHA cannot bypass approval or security controls.
title: Branch training-sandbox access - 4

content: Access Support handles unresolved setup while the branch manager remains a human contact, not an app role.
title: Branch training-sandbox access - 5

content: The fictional self-service account is the route for handbook-listed onboarding records and payslip access.
title: Employee self-service access - 1

content: AISHA can describe sign-in recovery steps but cannot see credentials, reset passwords, or confirm account state.
title: Employee self-service access - 2

content: A Hire should never paste a password, one-time code, or recovery answer into AISHA.
title: Employee self-service access - 3

content: Repeated sign-in failure is routed to Access Support using a concise non-secret summary.
title: Employee self-service access - 4

content: The account remains a Company Resource governed by security and acceptable-use requirements.
title: Employee self-service access - 5

content: Branch device setup follows the fictional asset handoff and local sign-in guidance.
title: Branch device setup - 1

content: AISHA may identify the owner and ordered setup steps but cannot inventory, unlock, or manage a device.
title: Branch device setup - 2

content: Device serial numbers and authentication secrets are not needed in ordinary Dialogue history.
title: Branch device setup - 3

content: Lost or damaged equipment requires immediate use of the official human reporting route.
title: Branch device setup - 4

content: Security controls are never weakened to complete onboarding more quickly.
title: Branch device setup - 5

content: Access is least-privilege and tied to the confirmed role, department, classification, and work site.
title: Information security access - 1

content: AISHA does not infer entitlement from semantic similarity or from another Hire's access.
title: Information security access - 2

content: Requests for credentials, bypasses, or confidential data are refused and routed safely.
title: Information security access - 3

content: Procedure pages explain subordinate steps and never establish a new entitlement.
title: Information security access - 4

content: Only the fictional system owner can confirm completion of an access request.
title: Information security access - 5

content: Facility entry guidance applies to the confirmed Work Site and does not establish real physical access.
title: Facility and branch entry - 1

content: AISHA may explain where the fictional branch contact appears in the directory.
title: Facility and branch entry - 2

content: A temporary visit does not change the confirmed Work Site used for future applicability.
title: Facility and branch entry - 3

content: A lost badge or unsafe situation is routed immediately without exposing identifying details.
title: Facility and branch entry - 4

content: The educational demo never connects to a building access-control system.
title: Facility and branch entry - 5

content: The remote-access kit applies only when Remote is the Hire's HR-confirmed Work Site.
title: Remote-access kit - 1

content: A temporary work-from-home day does not by itself establish eligibility.
title: Remote-access kit - 2

content: When the assigned Work Site is unclear, AISHA asks one focused question before providing personalized guidance.
title: Remote-access kit - 3

content: An Attribute Change Request requires explicit Hire consent and HR approval.
title: Remote-access kit - 4

content: AISHA never provisions a kit, VPN, account, device, or other Company Resource.
title: Remote-access kit - 5

content: This branch attendance guidance applies only to a Hire with Branch as the confirmed Work Site.
title: Branch attendance and office hours - 1

content: A temporary Head Office visit does not automatically update the Hire Profile.
title: Branch attendance and office hours - 2

content: Questions about a possible permanent move require one focused clarification and optional Attribute Change Request.
title: Branch attendance and office hours - 3

content: AISHA explains reporting steps but cannot approve leave, attendance corrections, or schedule changes.
title: Branch attendance and office hours - 4

content: Attendance support is framed as humane onboarding help rather than surveillance or performance scoring.
title: Branch attendance and office hours - 5

content: AISHA provides guide-plus-validate support and does not approve or deny leave.
title: Leave guidance - 1

content: Leave types and required steps must be supported by active policy evidence before a conclusion.
title: Leave guidance - 2

content: The Hire uses the separate fictional official route for a leave request or original document submission.
title: Leave guidance - 3

content: A private conversation is not an official filing and is not visible to HR by default.
title: Leave guidance - 4

content: Unsupported eligibility questions abstain and offer the active HR route.
title: Leave guidance - 5

content: The fictional conduct policy promotes respectful, safe, and inclusive workplace behavior.
title: Workplace conduct and support - 1

content: AISHA can identify support routes but is not an emergency service, investigator, or disciplinary system.
title: Workplace conduct and support - 2

content: Private chat transcripts are not shown to HR by default.
title: Workplace conduct and support - 3

content: A case summary must be displayed and explicitly approved before a consented escalation is created.
title: Workplace conduct and support - 4

content: Immediate safety concerns are redirected to appropriate local emergency and human channels.
title: Workplace conduct and support - 5

content: The local check requires patient full name, consultation date, issue date, absence start, and an end date or positive whole-day duration.
title: Medical certificate completeness requirements - 1

content: It also requires clinician full name, facility name, professional license or registration number presence, signature indication, and an explicit rest recommendation.
title: Medical certificate completeness requirements - 2

content: Dates use month-day-four-digit-year and are checked only for deterministic calendar and ordering consistency.
title: Medical certificate completeness requirements - 3

content: The patient first and last name must match the Hire Profile after conservative normalization; AISHA never guesses identity.
title: Medical certificate completeness requirements - 4

content: Every OCR-derived required field must be unambiguous at or above the configured threshold, with exactly one clearer-copy retry.
title: Medical certificate completeness requirements - 5

content: The check never authenticates a document, verifies a clinician, assesses a diagnosis, or approves leave.
title: Medical certificate completeness requirements - 6

content: Certificate bytes and extracted content are discarded; only closed result codes, citations, timing, and an installation-local fingerprint may remain.
title: Medical certificate completeness requirements - 7

content: The original certificate must still use the separate Official HR Document Route; result sharing with HR requires explicit consent.
title: Medical certificate completeness requirements - 8

content: AISHA gives HR enough structured signal to offer support, not private conversation content for surveillance.
title: Privacy and consent - 1

content: Escalation cases, attribute requests, and result sharing each require their own explicit consent action.
title: Privacy and consent - 2

content: Medical documents, OCR text, diagnoses, filenames, and extracted values never enter ordinary chat or telemetry.
title: Privacy and consent - 3

content: Alyssa may delete a conversation or Validation Result through the supported resource operation.
title: Privacy and consent - 4

content: Operational telemetry is content-free and is not a product audit trail.
title: Privacy and consent - 5

content: Routes resolve by policy, then subarea, then topic, then the HR fallback.
title: HR escalation and attribute confirmation - 1

content: An Escalation Offer creates no case until the Hire approves the displayed route and summary.
title: HR escalation and attribute confirmation - 2

content: Attribute Change Requests contain one closed attribute and no chat transcript or free-form private reason.
title: HR escalation and attribute confirmation - 3

content: Only the fictional HR User view may approve or reject a pending attribute request.
title: HR escalation and attribute confirmation - 4

content: A Manager is a human contact and never an AISHA app role.
title: HR escalation and attribute confirmation - 5

content: This standard applies only when Head Office is the confirmed Work Site.
title: Head-office dress standard - 1

content: Alyssa's seeded Branch Work Site therefore receives a cited Does Not Apply explanation.
title: Head-office dress standard - 2

content: A temporary Head Office visit may be explained abstractly without changing the Hire Profile.
title: Head-office dress standard - 3

content: A permanent move remains provisional until HR approves the one-attribute request.
title: Head-office dress standard - 4

content: AISHA does not invent appearance rules beyond the active policy text.
title: Head-office dress standard - 5

content: Grounded Answer, Clarification Request, Abstention, and Escalation Offer are the four typed Dialogue outcomes.
title: Glossary: policy responses

content: Applies, Does Not Apply, and Needs Clarification are deterministic outcomes; retrieval similarity never decides eligibility.
title: Glossary: applicability

content: A Handbook Omission differs from a Knowledge Index Outage or integrity failure, and each fails closed with a distinct outcome.
title: Glossary: retrieval

content: Payroll Support is the fictional route for pay schedule, payslip, deduction, and payroll correction questions.
title: Directory: Payroll Support

content: Access Support is the fictional route for accounts, devices, and other Company Resource guidance.
title: Directory: Access Support

content: HR General, HR Leave, and HR Privacy are fictional human routes selected by policy and subarea.
title: Directory: HR routes

content: Handbook v1.0 is the initial immutable edition. Only explicit supersession can establish precedence between revisions.
title: Version and supersession

content: AISHA never stores or submits an original medical certificate. The separate fictional Official HR Document Route remains required.
title: Official document route
